data.title: Support DOM VIRUS
data.subtitle: Keep the games coming.
lead: DOM VIRUS is a one-person passion project: a solo maker shipping roughly a game a week on the side. Every game is free to play, with no ads. Sponsorship and tip links go live soon. Here is how to help today.

body.text: One person designs, codes, tests and ships every game. There is no studio behind them, no ads and no paywall.
Support turns spare hours into more games, faster fixes and the servers that multiplayer will need.
A move from GitHub Pages to the site's own domain, domvirus.com, behind Cloudflare.
Domains for the family: domvirus.com, its game subdomains and a home for the Fizlet engine.
Servers for multiplayer rooms. Multiplayer is planned, and rooms need a small server that a static host cannot run.

blocks.heading: Ways to help today, for free

items.title: Play the games
items.body: Every play counts. Find a cartridge and press start.

items.title: Share a game
items.body: Send a game to a friend, or post it where your people hang out.

items.title: Report bugs and ideas
items.body: Every report makes the next release better.

body.text: GitHub Sponsors comes first, for monthly or one-time support through GitHub.
A tip jar, such as Ko-fi or Buy Me a Coffee, follows for one-off thanks.
The links appear on this page as soon as the accounts are live.

items.q: Can I sponsor DOM VIRUS today?
items.a: Not yet. The sponsorship and tip links appear here once the accounts are live. Until then, a share helps most.
Into the plans above: the move to domvirus.com, domains for the family and servers for multiplayer rooms.
Yes. Play the games, share a game and report bugs.

seo.title: Support DOM VIRUS: free games, one maker
seo.description: DOM VIRUS is a one-person passion project. See what support will pay for and how to help today: play the games, share them and report bugs.
